p.bio:
I’m quite new to sailing, I started towards the end of last year, but being surronded by so many great sailors on the team has taught me so much, so fast.
I love learning new things and trying out new challenges. I think time is valuable, and learning as many new skills as possible is one of the best ways to live. A few of my favourite hobbies include surfing, fishing and free diving, as I love all things to do with water. I also enjoy photography, hiking and essentially anything to do with nature because it is a true gift. A very recent hobby of mine has been jogging and I’ve really loved training for and competing in my first marathon. But something that has really fueled me is my passion for health, whether it be health of the mind or of the body.
I hope to continue sailing because it is such a beautifully composed sport and really teaches a lot: I especially love the way we humans learn to flow with nature through this athletic form of art.

c: African & Oceanian Qualifiers - SSL Gold Cup 2026
